[b]The Domus of Speaker Tito:  March 7th, 2025[/b]

Night had fallen over the bustling city of Gossen, the smell of the olive groves to the East of the city, however, though peace seemed to settle over the city, a rising tide seemed to be coming, and what was Doma to do?

She rarely visited her brother, primarily out of duty to the separation of the legislature and judicial, but also because it gathered suspicion amongst those within her family who held the reins of power. However, since her meeting with Theodora her mind had been racing to save or prevent her brother's potential death, indeed, she had heard how Alexander had rejected the offer that Theodora had made, and now Theodora most likely had returned to her original plan.

Moving swiftly down the cobbled street where oil lamps guttered and a city guard leaned against a wall, snoozing lazily, she arrived before the high walled domus of her brother, two large red gates made up the entrance. Knocking swiftly she was greeted by  a servantgirl who let her into the small entry courtyard. From here she made her way to the still lit office of her brother, its window open to the central courtyard of the domus. 

Brother, stated Doma as she briskly strolled into the office where Tito was scribbling down some work or order on a parchment, he looked up in surprise.

Doma? What brings you here? he enquired, slightly offput by his sisters decision to visit him, You know he began before being cut off by his sister.

I know! she snapped slightly, However, this is urgent, she stated, seating herself without waiting for her brother to motion for her to do so.

Well? enquired her brother, startled at her abruptness.

I shall not mince my words, Lady Ptolenos plans to remove you, stated Doma bluntly, eying her brother to gauge his reaction, which was slow and cautious.

Is that so? he enquired gently, pondering the potentialities that lay within the statement that which his sister had said. 

Yes, replied Doma, a tinge of frustration entering her voice as her brother continued to meander with the thought, Surely you are not so blind to think that your position is safe, continued Doma.

No, I did not, I knew this was coming, replied Tito, seeming to snap out of his stupor as his eyes finally fixed upon his sister. 

Then what are you going to do? enquired Doma, prodding to see if he really had considered the possibility.

Nothing, for the moment, replied Tito, To shift would be to uncover the wolf's lair, and thereby launch into chaotic disarray, the government, he continued, his voice taking on a philosophical air, causing Doma to internally consider killing him herself out of sheer annoyance. 

Dear brother, please, I need concrete plans, not philosophical musings, I can only support you so much, she stated calmly.

I do apologise, but what else is there to do? enquired Tito.

Well perhaps we can move against the Ptolenos before they against you, or me, she stated.

But how? enquired Tito, We must preserve order, any harsh or rash moves would lead to chaos, as I have mentioned before, he continued.

My dear brother, you are too legalistic in this, it is a wonder you havent been made a justice of the Supreme Court, replied Doma sardonically, once again frustrated at her brothers lack of foresight. 

Now, there are two options, she continued, First you can step aside and appoint a loyalist, or you can stay and utilise the rising popular dissent to mobilise the Senate to action, she stated counting off the options on her fingers.

Only two options? enquired Tito, tilting his head to her, Now who is being simple-minded, he stated jokingly. 

Have you any allies? enquired Doma, intending to strike at his ego but failing as his eyes seemed to brighten.

Yes, several, from the kingdom, replied Tito firmly, referring to the Kingdom of Thýven, the more powerful and wealthy state that North Thýven had broken away from in 1964. 

Doma raised her eyebrows at the mention of Thýven, frowning slightly, Why should we involve foreign agents in our affairs? she stated, skeptical.

Why should we involve any agents, my dear sister? enquired Tito, I am just giving you the seeds, you can now water them, he replied, leading his sister along.

Doma groaned internally as she replied, Do not play the long game with me brother, your blood is on your head,.

Fine, he said, pouting slightly, I had much fun with it, he muttered aside, before straightening once more and beginning to lay out the details, The Ptolenos are a threat to the Kingdom of Thýven, President Consantins ambition seems to be too much for the balance that is maintained down there, as a result, they have been looking for a way to displace him or remove him, this reason has now come to fruition via the senate and the Chamber of the Peoples, he stated in an analytical tone, which made Doma aware she was going to be here for a while.

Now, I have contacts with a local protest group that has some funding from Thýven, their leader is a member of the House Pogyros, if I can meet with her, I might be able to provide a distraction from where we can draw the attention of the president from myself to other matters, he continued.

Interesting, replied Doma, Where would I figure in this? she enquired.

Well, with the new coalition in the Chamber of the Peoples the budget bill is bound to pass, I am sure some strings are attached there, all you have to do is cause a ruckus in the courts with the bill, perhaps a provision is slightly off-toe or something else, if the ruckus is big enough, it should drive the people further against the Ptolenos, replied Tito.

And what of the heir? Enquired Doma, He is heavily involved in the affairs of the legislature, being a voting member, she stated.

He will be taking a brief recess to visit his wife during the time of debate and voting for the budget bill, I suspect he believes the coalition is strong, replied Tito.

Doma nodded, Shrewd and cunning, I had no idea you had that in you brother, she replied, rising from the chair.

I am a man of principle, but what those principles are, you have to guess, he replied, giving his sister a wink.

With that Doma left into the night, her mind considering the paths for the plan to go, it was risky, and no doubt there were others also plotting.
